prior_findings: V2.8.1 stage-1: 0/9 factors promoted; do not reuse failed rules as a positive claim
EXPLORATORY_OPENING_GAP_V1: lowest opening gaps did not outperform; do not reverse or retune that hypothesis
question: Does high daily closing-location strength at a predeclared as-of close outperform the same-day eligible equal-weight A-share universe over the next five joint trading sessions, after a fixed cost haircut?

signal.observable_at: D-close after final D high, low, close are known
signal.price_integrity: Only finite positive high, low and close; require high>low, low<=close<=high; duplicate security/date must fail
signal.membership: Official V2.8.1 PIT intervals and vendor-stable stock symbols; no ex-post sample substitution
signal.selection: Select top ceil(10%*N) CLV values per joint trading session D; descending CLV; ascending canonical ID deterministic tie-break
signal.zero_range_and_missing: Exclude from signal-eligible universe, account explicitly; no substitute security
signal.strength_direction: higher close location preferred; no alternative directions tested
signal.parameter_grid: None; one hypothesis, one 10% fraction, one five-session outcome

population.source: V2.8.1 pinned AlphaDojo daily stock and CSI300 parquet hashes plus official PIT ledger and fixed joint calendars

outcome.entry_reference: close_D, idealized mark not certified executable because selection needs full D close/high/low
outcome.target: close_Dplus5 on the exact fifth subsequent joint A-share trading session, no next-observed-date substitution
outcome.primary_comparison: Equal-weight average selected realized D-to-Dplus5 return minus 0.003, minus equal-weight mean of all same-day signal-eligible resolved outcomes (gross). Aggregate by signal date with equal date weights
outcome.secondary_comparison: CSI300 D-close to Dplus5-close when both pinned benchmark closes exist; diagnostic only
outcome.missing_target: Missing selected Dplus5 close is unresolved; selected vs broad outcome coverage reported, never set missing returns to zero or shift dates
outcome.correlated_events_note: Overlapping five-session event returns are NOT independent trades and are NOT a portfolio-path backtest

test_plan.unit: signal day, not pooled independent security-date events
test_plan.primary_statistic: mean daily selected-net minus all-eligible gross five-session return

block_bootstrap.reported: 5th and 95th percentiles of mean daily excess; descriptive serial-correlation-aware uncertainty

test_plan.exploratory_positive_only_if: >=200 evaluated days; selected return coverage >=0.90; 2025 and 2026 nonpristine period mean excess both >0; overall mean excess >0; 20-date-block bootstrap p05 >0
test_plan.interpretation: A positive exploratory result still needs a genuinely uninspected independently defined future OOS period, realistic execution and predeclared strength criteria; historical 2026 cannot be relabeled pristine OOS

frozen_commit_policy: Commit this prereg before running any outcome-processing code for this experiment; do not revise its selection, horizon, window, metrics, cost or decision criteria in response to observed outcomes
allowed_repairs: Only implementation errors preserving this exact contract; record every attempt and prohibit alternate selection rules
